name: switch
title: Switch
description: On/off toggle built on a native checkbox with role switch, no JavaScript needed in Blade.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text next to the switch, linked through for/id.

props.name: checked / defaultChecked / v-model
props.description: On state. Blade uses the checked attribute, React checked or defaultChecked, Vue v-model.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: React only. Called with the new state every time the switch changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the switch and dims the label.

a11y: A native checkbox input with role switch, so screen readers announce on or off from the checked state.
Space toggles the state, and clicking the label toggles it too.
The thumb is decorative (aria-hidden) and moves through CSS peer-checked.

ai.whenToUse: Settings that apply immediately without a save button, such as notifications or data saver mode.
rules: Use Checkbox when the change only applies after the form is submitted
The label describes what gets turned on, not the current state

id.description: Saklar nyala/mati dari checkbox native dengan role switch, tanpa JavaScript di Blade.

props.label: Teks label di samping saklar, terhubung lewat for/id.
props.checked / defaultChecked / v-model: Status nyala. Blade memakai atribut checked, React checked atau defaultChecked, Vue v-model.
props.onCheckedChange: Khusus React. Dipanggil dengan status baru setiap kali saklar berubah.
props.id: Id input. Dibuat otomatis kalau kosong.

a11y: Input checkbox native dengan role switch, sehingga screen reader membacakan aktif atau nonaktif dari status checked.
Spasi mengubah status, label yang diklik ikut mengubah status.
Thumb hanya dekorasi (aria-hidden) dan bergerak lewat CSS peer-checked.

ai.whenToUse: Pengaturan yang langsung berlaku tanpa tombol simpan, misalnya notifikasi atau mode hemat data.
rules: Pakai Checkbox kalau perubahan baru berlaku setelah form dikirim
Label menjelaskan apa yang dinyalakan, bukan status saat ini
